_comment: The official MaidCentral API, transcribed from the docs (support.maidcentral.com/llms.txt, section 'v1-api'). One entry per documented endpoint. 'verified' = called successfully by npm run probe. Response shapes come from capture/output/official-probe.jsonl, not from here. 'query' lists documented query parameters (* = required).
status: Docs read end to end on 2026-11-02: 23 endpoints including /token, all under /api/Lead and /api/Note. The API covers the online-booking funnel (leads, quotes, pricing, availability, booking) plus notes and a few lookups. It has no endpoints for existing clients, jobs, the schedule, employees, payroll or invoices. Not probed yet (no API user in the session).
auth: POST /token (form-encoded) with username and password (grant_type=password), or refresh_token (grant_type=refresh_token); then Authorization: Bearer <token>. Credentials come from an API User (Company > Settings > General > Integrations > API Users).
envelope: Every /api response is { IsSuccess, Message, Result, InnerException, StatusCode }.

endpoints.purpose: Get a bearer token for the API user (grant_type=password) or refresh it (grant_type=refresh_token)
Create or update a lead (contact details, postal code, source, tags)
Get a lead
Create or update a quote for a lead (home, scopes, answers, rate modifications)
Get a quote
Book a quote (turns it into scheduled service). Card details only as a CardConnect iFrame token; Stripe and Authorize.Net not supported
Attach UTM data to a lead or quote
Calculate a price without creating a lead
Scope groups (service categories), with their scopes and frequencies
Scopes (services) in a scope group
Frequency options for a scope
Rate modifications (extras, add-ons) for a scope group
Booking and pricing questions for one or more scopes
Available job dates for a scope group (hours or amount required)
Serviceable postal codes by home zone
Customer sources (lookup)
Billing terms (lookup)
